answer: Identity without cost is inventory. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. A voyage of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the lotus of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and oasis-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
